note: Seaside 2nd Edition (2022) — 27 kingdom cards transcribed from the official rulebook. Secluded Isle is a separate 12-card pile at 3+ players (8 at 2). Durations stay in play after Clean-up and resolve at the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Hourglass
cards.text: Now and at the start of your next turn: +1 Buy, +$1.

cards.name: Souk
cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions; +$1.

cards.name: Stockpile
cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $4, setting it aside. At the start of your next turn, put it into your hand. While it's set aside, when another player gains a copy of it on their turn, they gain a Bane.

cards.name: Wagon Train
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action. At the start of your next turn, +1 Card.

cards.name: Buccaneer
cards.text: +$2. At the start of your next turn: +1 Card. Until then, each other player trashes the first Silver Coin or Gold Coin they play each turn.

cards.name: Pickpocket
cards.text: +$2; each other player discards a Bronze Coin (or reveals a hand with no Bronze Coin).

cards.name: Fishing Dock
cards.text: +2 Actions; +$1. At the start of your next turn: +1 Action and +$1.

cards.name: Refuge
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action. Set aside a card from your hand face down (under this). At the start of your next turn, put it into your hand.

cards.name: Secluded Isle
cards.text: Put this and a card from your hand onto your Secluded Isle mat.

cards.name: Beacon
cards.text: +1 Action; +$1. At the start of your next turn: +$1. Until then, when another player plays an Attack card, it doesn't affect you.

cards.name: Ranger
cards.text: +1 Action. Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Trash one of them. Discard one of them. Put the other one back on top of your deck.

cards.name: Galleon
cards.text: Now and at the start of your next turn: +$2.

cards.name: Parrot
cards.text: Until your next turn, when the player to your right gains a card, +1 Card. At the start of your next turn: +1 Card.

cards.name: Frontier Camp
cards.text: +2 Actions. Choose one: Put the top card of your deck face down on your Frontier Camp mat (you may look at those cards at any time); or put all the cards from your mat into your hand.

cards.name: Fort
cards.text: If this is the first time you played a Fort this turn, and the previous turn wasn't yours, then take an extra turn after this one, and you only draw 3 cards for your next hand.

cards.name: Sea Rover
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, gain a Treasure costing up to $5 to your hand. When any player gains a Treasure, you may play this from your hand.

cards.name: First Mate
cards.text: +1 Action. Once this turn, when you gain a Duration card, you may play it. At the start of your next turn: +$1 and you may trash a card from your hand.

cards.name: Scavenger
cards.text: +1 Buy. Trash a card from your hand. +$1 per $1 it costs.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action. Reveal the top card of your deck. If you have a copy of it in play, put it into your hand.

cards.name: Siren
cards.text: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Bane. At the start of your next turn: +2 Cards, then discard 2 cards.

cards.name: Bootleggers
cards.text: Gain a copy of a card costing up to $6 that the player to your right gained on their last turn.

cards.name: Strategist
cards.text: If you have at least one card in hand: Discard your hand, and at the start of your next turn: +5 Cards, +1 Action, and +1 Buy.

cards.name: Whirlpool
cards.text: +3 Cards; +1 Action. At the start of your next turn, discard 2 cards.

cards.name: Treasure Chart
cards.text: Trash this and a Treasure Chart from your hand. If you trashed two Treasure Charts, gain 4 Gold Coins onto your deck.

cards.name: Coffer
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +$1. At the end of your Buy phase this turn, if you didn't gain a Victory card in it, you may put this onto your deck.

cards.name: Granary
cards.text: +3 Cards; +1 Action. Discard 3 cards.

cards.name: Dock
cards.text: Now and at the start of your next turn: +2 Cards and +1 Buy.
